question: Announced in February 2022, which of the following organisations is one of the partners of the Sustainable Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Delivery of Healthcare (SAMRIDH) initiative?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​NITI Aayog.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and USAID** have declared new cooperation under the **SAMRIDH initiative.**
 
• SAMRIDH's full form is **Sustainable Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Delivery of Healthcare.**
 
• **The revolutionary SAMRIDH enterprise combined finance facility**, generated by the Indian government, academia, and the **business sector in 2020,** merges public and philanthropic money with commercial capital to generate and quickly scale market-based health solutions.
 
• The enterprise came into existence as a cooperation between the** Niti Aayog of India and the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID).**
 
• **NITI Aayog's entire gamut of projects can be divided into four important heads**: Policy and Programme Framework, Cooperative Federalism, Monitoring and Evaluation, Think Tank, and Knowledge and Innovation Hub.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) **is the Central Drug Authority for discharging functions allotted to the Central Government in the process of the **Drugs and Cosmetics Act.**
 
• **The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare **is an Indian administrative ministry charged with health policy in India. 
 
• **Pharmaceuticals** have contributed to improvements in life expectancy and the standard of life of many patients.​
